KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
